question: Which records lack a value in the selected field?

steps.name: records
steps.soql: SELECT Id, {field}, LastModifiedDate FROM {obj} WHERE {field} = null ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {records.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: The field must be queryable and filterable; the object must support Id and LastModifiedDate.
Null is not the same as whitespace, a default value or a business-invalid value. No values are filled automatically.
